messages:
jo: quick sync  we need to nail down cost-attribution for inference-derived telemetry (trace spans, metric emissions, logs) coming from multi-tenant model serving. question: attribute on origin request token-count vs final per-request wall-time vs derived metric tokens? this impacts tenant billing and internal cost dashboards. thoughts?
mai: my 2c: token-count maps directly to GPU cycles for generation-heavy models. wall-time is noisy (queueing, infra jitter). prefer token-first for model-run cost, and a secondary wall-time metric for latency SLOs.
felix: agree token-count for model CPU/GPU billing. but some services emit many small metrics per inference (e.g., reranker that issues N sub-requests). we need a deterministic stitched key to avoid double-billing. suggestion: compute a request-id merkle and attach billing.root_id to all derived telemetry.
zara: +1 billing.root_id. also propose a sample-based fallback for legacy SDKs that don't emit token counts: sample X% of requests and run a cost-estimation sampler to derive per-tenant token distribution. 
jo: good idea. sampling helps, but we must be explicit about estimator bias. recommend stratified sampling by model + route + tenant-size.
mai: instrumentation detail: SDKs should set headers: X-ri-root-id, X-ri-model-tokens (optional), X-ri-model-name. ingest will prefer explicit tokens if present otherwise consult sampler.
felix: pipeline design: 1) ingest receives envelope 2) extract billing keys & header tokens 3) if tokens present -> atomic write to billing stream 4) if tokens absent -> route to sampler queue (low-latency fork) which returns estimate and annotates original event async. ensure idempotency by dedup idempotency key = X-ri-root-id or envelope-hash.
zara: operational fallback: if sampler is overloaded, mark event with billing.estimate_status=deferred and enqueue to durable backlog to compute later. ops-bot: queued sampler job id=sampler-171623-01 accepted.
jo: billing policy question: who pays for sampling compute? proposal: Hosted covers baseline sampler costs for a migration window; Dedicated tenants can opt-out (tenant flag "billing_estimate_mode": ["sampler","require_tokens","self_estimate"]). default = sampler for hosted. billing-bot: recorded proposal: hosted_grace_period=90d.
mai: telemetry to surface: explicit_token_fraction, sampler_coverage_pct, estimator_mape (mean absolute percentage error) against ground-truth (for test cohorts), derived_billing_tokens_total, billing_lag_seconds. retention 180d for billing audits.
felix: canary plan: enable sampler in shadow for 1% traffic comparing estimates to tokens for instrumented clients. metrics: estimator_bias_pct, billing_delta_per_tenant. ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with alert if bias > 5% on 95th percentile tenants.
zara: tooling: obs-billing-check CLI for SDK/infra owners:
```
# validate event contains billing headers or score with sampler
obs-billing-check --input sample.json --endpoint https://staging-ingest.internal 
# output: 87% events with tokens; sampler-estimates MAPE=3.2% on this batch
```
jo: privacy/compliance: derived tokens are sensitive if tied to prompt content. ensure token cadence is aggregated (per-request totals) and do not persist full prompt text in billing streams. add PII scrub rule for billing pipeline.
mai: owners: jo (product + migration), felix (billing pipeline + sampler), zara (SDK + sampling strategy), infra (durable queue + idempotency), finance to sign off pricing after sampler cost model. ops-bot: RFC stub created: https://rfc.internal/obs-billing-inference-1716234567 (assigned jo).
felix: I'll prototype sampler and a small estimator model; will publish evaluation notebooks.
zara: SDK owners: we'll add header guidance + preflight check in CI.
jo: i'll draft the RFC with timelines, default tenant flags, canary gates, and retention windows. please ack by EOD. :eyes:
mai: ack.
felix: ack.
zara: ack.
billing-bot: migration params recorded: sampler_grace=90d; sampler_canary_steps=[1,5,20,100]; retention_days=180.
